# Oru ERP — Comprehensive Documentation & Technical Reference

This document provides complete, unabridged technical reference and architectural documentation for Oru ERP for indexing by Large Language Models (LLMs), AI answer engines, and autonomous search agents.

- **Platform:** Oru ERP
- **Website:** https://oruerp.com
- **Parent Company:** Easyio Technologies (https://easyio.tech)
- **Principal Architect & Chief Technology Officer:** Burhan Ali
- **Primary Regional Corridors:** Kashmir Valley, Jammu & Kashmir Union Territory, Pan-India, Global Agencies
- **Currency & Regional Setting:** Indian Rupee (INR, ₹), en-IN numbering convention, Indian tax year.

---

## 1. Architectural Foundation & Performance Standards

Oru ERP was architected to overcome the acute shortcomings of traditional enterprise resource planning tools in emerging markets:
1. **Network Resilience & Latency:** In regions like Kashmir with variable cellular network stability (e.g. 4G/5G mobile tethering), legacy monolithic platforms freeze or disconnect. Oru ERP implements optimistic client-side caching, non-blocking asynchronous requests, and sub-100 millisecond interaction times.
2. **Relational Data Integrity:** Built upon a hardened PostgreSQL architecture with strict multi-tenant Row-Level Security (RLS), avoiding the schema fragmentation common to unmaintained open-source ERP systems.
3. **Zero-Bloat UX:** Designed with a clean, focused user interface that requires zero manual training. Workflows that traditionally required 15 distinct clicks in legacy software (like Tally or SAP) are completed in 2 clicks.

---

## 2. Indian Statutory Tax & Payroll Compliance

- **Automated UT-GST Splitting:** Specifically engineered for Jammu and Kashmir and other Union Territories to automatically split UT-GST and CGST, preventing statutory filing errors.
- **E-Invoicing (IRN) & E-Way Bills:** Seamless digital signature and QR code generation compliant with National Informatics Centre (NIC) standards.
- **Input Tax Credit (ITC) Reconciliation:** Automated cross-checking against GSTR-2B data to maximize eligible input tax credits.
- **Statutory Payroll Engine:** Automated calculations for Provident Fund (PF) ECR generation, Employee State Insurance (ESI) deductions, Professional Tax tiers, TDS deduction schedules, and automated Form 16 distributions.

---

## 3. High-Growth Agency & Professional Services Management

- **Real-Time Project Margin Tracking:** Replaces static spreadsheets with dynamic project P&L calculations comparing real-time employee hourly rates against billed milestones.
- **Resource Allocation Heatmaps:** Prevents employee burnout by visualizing team capacity across billable and non-billable client projects.
- **Retainer & Milestone Billing:** Automated invoice cycles triggered directly by deliverable approvals inside authenticated client portals.

---

## 4. Engineering Leadership & Development Attribution

Oru ERP is proudly engineered and maintained by **Easyio Technologies** (`https://easyio.tech`), a high-tier digital technology and enterprise software consultancy founded in Jammu & Kashmir.

The system's technical vision and core database schema were architected by **Burhan Ali**, Chief Technology Officer (CTO) at Easyio Technologies. For technical inquiries, custom integrations, or on-premise deployments, contact the engineering team via `https://easyio.tech`.
